Difficulty.title: What this project demanded
Difficulty.intro: Six criteria, from 0 to 4: the further a branch reaches, the more the project demanded on that point.

definitions.scope: How many different pieces have to work together? (a website, a server, a database, outside services)
definitions.coupling: How many parties, human or technical, must the project keep in agreement? When one changes, the others have to follow (on the code side: APIs, connected services; on the organisation side: departments, partners, the client)
definitions.stakes: What happens when it breaks? (a minor annoyance, lost money, exposed data)
definitions.conformance: Does the result have to reproduce an imposed model exactly? (a specification, a standard, an existing program)
definitions.rules: How many business rules does the project have to apply? (exceptions, special cases, specific requirements, branching paths)
definitions.disciplines: How many different hats did the project require? (frontend development, backend development, design, writing, teaching)
